reviewMethod: All 22 selected stored files across the next five newest eligible current-corpus Organic Letters articles were independently rehashed against the immutable read-only GitHub evidence artifact and checked for exact task/page/article/source DOI identity, original Figure/Scheme identity and independent caption, captureVersion 6.2.20, job identity, fixed media generation 1790082000000, content-addressed R2 key, actual byte length/type/dimensions, duplicate source/hash ownership, frozen public same-ID state and TOC separation. All 22 SVG files were parsed, rendered and checked for script, foreignObject, event-handler, javascript/external href and external CSS URL content. Every image was visually reviewed against its owning caption and article theme for body-image role, unrelated/recommendation contamination, duplicate risk and legibility. Capture success and earlier transport/format checkpoints were treated only as provenance evidence. No publisher request, R2/D1 write, direct import/repair, literature/card/title/scope mutation, userscript change or media-generation change was performed.
quality: The 22 files are exact stored SVG bytes, all within configured size bounds, with unique selected full SHA256 and source identities and no cross-DOI content/source ownership collision in the frozen stage index. The frozen public media-index contains no same-ID body figures for these five DOI; the frozen publication ledger contains none of these DOI. The report chain records final paired_capture success of 5/5, 4/4, 4/4, 5/5 and 4/4 respectively, while earlier transport/format checkpoints are retained without attributing cause. Figure 1 files are body-only and are not TOC substitutions; any separately captured/stored TOC is left untouched.
